subject: GCP Marketplace procurement & onboarding: Gate checklist and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@cloudaxis.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: GCP Marketplace procurement & onboarding: Gate checklist and next steps

Hi Julia —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our call, attaching a concise procurement + onboarding gate checklist so your procurement and cloud teams can map required artifacts and a tentative timeline. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm billing contact and PO cadence (monthly vs. annual).
- Confirm required contract signer and procurement contact (legal / SSO).
- Review SKU mapping we propose for entitlements.

Attached: redwood_gcp_procurement_gate_checklist.xlsx (fills in required artifacts), gcp_sku_mapping_v1.csv (initial mapping), redwood_draft_mou_20261122.pdf (starter).

Proposed next steps if this looks good:
1) You confirm procurement contact + PO timing by Tue 11/24.
2) We run a short security/compliance handoff with your cloud team on Thu 11/26.
3) Sign MOU and create listing entry the week of 11/30.

Would you prefer we loop in our finance ops (Naomi) now or after you confirm PO cadence?

Thanks — looking forward to closing the runway.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_gcp_procurement_gate_checklist.xlsx, gcp_sku_mapping_v1.csv, redwood_draft_mou_20261122.pdf

From: Julia Park <julia@cloudaxis.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudAxis Procurement <procurement@cloudaxis.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace procurement & onboarding: Gate checklist and next steps

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear checklist. A few quick questions from procurement and engineering after an internal review: 

1) For the SKU mapping: can you confirm whether the entitlements are billed at invoice creation or usage? Our billing team needs that to map to our chargeback system.
2) The MOU references an annual PO flow; we sometimes do monthly retainer POs for marketplace listings. Can Redwood support monthly invoices with net-30?
3) Security handoff: our cloud infra lead wants to see the SOC2 artifact and a short network diagram for the private listing flow. Is that available pre-signature or after MOU countersign?

Procurement contact for CloudAxis is procurement@cloudaxis.com (cc'd). They'd like an itemized cost estimate for a 12-month forecast (low / expected / high usage).

We can target Tue 11/24 for the PO cadence confirmation but would prefer to have the SOC2 and the network diagram before committing to a monthly billing template.

—Julia Park
Head of Partnerships | CloudAxis
julia@cloudaxis.com
+1 (650) 555-0143

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: procurement@cloudaxis.com, Julia Park <julia@cloudaxis.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace procurement & onboarding: Gate checklist and next steps

Hi Julia / CloudAxis procurement team —

Quick answers to your points below and a small ask for timeline alignment: 

1) Billing model: Redwood supports both invoice-on-usage and invoice-on-commit. For marketplace listings we default to usage invoicing unless a customer requests a committed/annual SKU. If you prefer monthly retainer with net-30 we can make that work; Naomi (cc) will confirm billing cadence and any minimums.

2) MOU and signature flow: we can accommodate monthly POs. The MOU is intentionally lightweight — we can add a billing cadence addendum. If you need DocuSign we can route it after we agree the PO template.

3) Security artifacts: SOC2 Type II report (redacted) and a private-listing network diagram are attached for your infra team's review. We typically share the redacted SOC2 before countersign and provide full evidence under an NDA if required.

Attached: gcp_sku_mapping_v1.csv (annotated), redwood_gcp_procurement_gate_checklist.xlsx (updated comments), redwood_draft_mou_20261122.pdf

Action items: 
- Procurement@cloudaxis to confirm preferred PO cadence (monthly vs annual) and provide sample PO template by 11/25.
- CloudAxis infra team to review SOC2/network diagram and reply with any blockers by 11/26.
- Naomi to confirm invoicing minimums and lead time for monthly retainer option.

If that timeline works we'll schedule the compliance handoff on Thu 11/26 at 11am PT.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

From: Julia Park <julia@cloudaxis.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace procurement & onboarding: Gate checklist and next steps

Hi Laura / team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Procurement confirmed they can do monthly POs with net-30 provided the invoice shows usage detail per SKU (your mapping helps). Our infra team reviewed the SOC2 redaction and the network diagram — no blockers, just one request: a short one-page note explaining the private listing connectivity model (firewall rules and who manages NAT) to share with our security ops.

Procurement will send a sample PO template by EOD 11/25. We can proceed with DocuSign after you send the updated MOU with the billing cadence addendum. I'll follow up with a DocuSign link once I have the final MOU from you.

Proposed live items:
- Naomi to confirm any invoice minimums / billing lead time.
- Karthik / Marissa to finalize marketplace listing metadata required by GCP (logos, product description, screenshots) — we'll coordinate via a short intake call.
- Laura to send the MOU update & one-page connectivity note by Wed 11/25.

I'll loop in procurement@cloudaxis.com on the PO template.

Thanks — Julia
